context: Two managers discuss a launch event
purpose: Teach: 長谷川/戸田/松下/原田/小島/大野/吉川/柴田

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新商品発表、長谷川さんと戸田さんがプレゼン。
lines.en: The product launch presentation—Hasegawa and Toda are handling the presentation.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient clip on each name. Matter-of-fact delivery. No flourish—this is business running as planned. Slight forward lean in posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。松下さんが司会、原田さんがQ&A補助です。
lines.en: Right. Matsushita's doing the MC, and Harada's on Q&A support.
lines.style: Acknowledging nod in the voice. Steady, collaborative tone. Each role stated with quiet confidence. Warm agreement without elaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小島さんはメディア対応、大野さんが場内案内。
lines.en: Kojima's handling media relations, and Ono's on floor guidance.
lines.style: Crisp, directional. Each assignment delivered with the weight of responsibility. Slight pause between names—letting each role land. Clear-eyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 吉川さんが資料配布、柴田さんが映像担当です。
lines.en: Yoshikawa's distributing materials, and Shibata's in charge of the visuals.
lines.style: Steady update cadence. No hesitation—these are facts being confirmed. Neutral, professional. Completes each pair before moving to the next.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Satisfied quiet. Breath of relief underneath. Final note—a period, not a question. Eyes forward. The calm of a plan coming together.
